c1-jas-0008: Two visitors walk into the assembly, one poor and one finely dressed. Read James 2:2.
c2-jas-0002: James talks to people making big plans for a city trip. Read James 4:14.
c2-jas-0003: The finely dressed visitor gets a good place. What about the poor man? Read James 2:3 and James 2:4.
c2-jas-0004: Workers were cheated of their pay, and their cries went up. Read James 5:3 and James 5:4.
c3-jas-0001: James asks, “Is anyone among you sick?” Let's read James 5:13 and James 5:14.
c3-jas-0002: James warns the wealthy, and he speaks of what God has chosen. Read James 2:5 and James 5:1.
c3-jas-0003: “Draw near to God and He will draw near to you.” Read James 4:8 and James 5:16.
c3-jas-0004: James says knowing the good and not doing it is sin. Read James 2:10 and James 4:17.
c1-1pe-0002: Peter tells the elders to shepherd the flock. Look ahead with First Peter 5:4.
c2-1pe-0006: Peter tells believers to open their homes to one another. Read First Peter 4:9.
c2-1pe-0007: Peter says no one should suffer for doing wrong. Read First Peter 4:15 and First Peter 4:16.
c2-1pe-0008: Peter asks elders to care for the flock willingly. Read First Peter 5:2 and First Peter 5:3.
c3-1pe-0003: Peter says it is God's will that His people do good. Read First Peter 2:14 and First Peter 2:15.
c3-1pe-0004: Peter calls believers bondservants of God, each with a gift to share. Read First Peter 2:16 and First Peter 4:10.
c3-1pe-0005: Some people speak against the good way believers live. Peter tells more in First Peter 2:12 and First Peter 3:16.
c3-1pe-0006: Peter asks elders to be examples to the flock. Read First Peter 3:13 and First Peter 5:3.
c1-1jn-0002: John tells his little children what time it is. Read First John 2:18.
c2-1jn-0006: John says the anointing from Him stays in believers. Read First John 2:27.
c2-1jn-0007: Some people went out from the believers. Read what John says in First John 2:19 and First John 2:26.
c2-1jn-0008: John speaks of a time when our own heart condemns us. Read First John 3:20 and First John 3:21.
c3-1jn-0003: John says we ought to lay down our lives for each other. Read First John 3:16 and First John 3:17.
c3-1jn-0004: We have an Advocate with the Father! Read First John 2:1 and First John 3:8.
c3-1jn-0005: John says the little children are of God. Read First John 2:22 and First John 4:4.
c3-1jn-0006: John says we know He abides in us by the Spirit He gave. Read First John 3:24 and First John 4:6.
c1-eph-0007: Paul says not to grieve the Holy Spirit. Read Ephesians 4:30.
c2-eph-0001: Paul writes to the Ephesians as dear children. Read Ephesians 5:1.
c2-eph-0002: Paul tells us to put away lying and speak truth with our neighbor. Read Ephesians 4:25 and Ephesians 4:26.
c2-eph-0003: Paul warns about the sons of disobedience. Read Ephesians 5:6 and Ephesians 5:7.
c3-eph-0002: Psalms, hymns, and spiritual songs! Paul says more in Ephesians 5:19 and Ephesians 5:20.
c3-eph-0003: Christ loved the church and gave Himself for her. Read Ephesians 5:2 and Ephesians 5:25.
c3-eph-0004: Paul tells us to put on the new man, created in true righteousness and holiness. Read Ephesians 4:24 and Ephesians 5:27.
c3-eph-0005: Paul tells fathers not to stir their children to wrath. Read Ephesians 4:31 and Ephesians 6:4.
c1-jud-0001: Jude opens his letter by calling himself a bondservant. Read Jude 1:1.
c2-jud-0001: Jude says Enoch spoke ahead of time about these men. Read Jude 1:14.
c2-jud-0002: Jude speaks of men who ran after Balaam's error and Korah's rebellion. Read Jude 1:11 and Jude 1:16.
c2-jud-0003: Jude says mockers would come in the last time. Read Jude 1:18 and Jude 1:19.
c3-jud-0001: Jude reminds the beloved that mockers were spoken of before. Read Jude 1:17 and Jude 1:18.
c3-jud-0002: Jude tells believers to keep themselves while looking for mercy. Read Jude 1:21 and Jude 1:24.
c3-jud-0003: Jude urges his readers to contend earnestly. Read Jude 1:3 and Jude 1:15.
c3-jud-0004: Jude prays that mercy, peace, and love be multiplied to you. Read Jude 1:2 and Jude 1:20.
